On the left side of the image, there is a white gas stove with a white oven and a white countertop. Above the stove, there are shelves with various kitchen utensils and dishes. In the center of the kitchen, next to the stove is a large window with a view of the outside. In front of the window is a gray trash can and a black stool. The kitchen appears to be clean and well-maintained.
